title.value: Understanding the Behaviour of Neural Abstractive Summarizers using Contrastive Examples
title.justification: The title explicitly states the main focus of the research paper, which is examining neural abstractive summarization via contrastive examples.
title.quote: Understanding the Behaviour of Neural Abstractive Summarizers using  Contrastive Examples

analysis.description: This paper investigates how neural abstractive summarization systems perform by using contrastive examples that are perturbed versions of human-written summaries. It evaluates the systems' abilities to prioritize human-written summaries over contrastive, incorrect ones by analyzing their performance on different datasets. The research aims to determine whether these systems truly understand the syntactic and semantic structures they process.

type.justification: The research involves practical testing and evaluation of existing neural abstractive summarization models with concrete datasets to assess their performance.
type.quote: We generate a set of contrastive summaries which are perturbed, deficient versions of human-written summaries, and test whether existing neural summarizers score them more highly than the human-written summaries.
